name: Elite Electronic Systems
old_description: Elite Electronic Systems is a leading provider of high-reliability Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) for regulated and performance-driven markets.
about:
Elite Electronic Systems was founded in 1986 and operates from three UK sites: Enniskillen in Northern Ireland, Livingston in Scotland, and Chesterfield in England. The business began as an electronics manufacturing services provider and has grown to employ over 300 people across its facilities.

The company delivers full-spectrum EMS, including PCB assembly, cable and box-build assembly, control systems integration, new product introduction (NPI) support, and test services. It manages programs from prototype through to volume production, offering design-for-manufacture guidance, full component sourcing, and global logistics. A dedicated NPI process and a four-day working week for staff are noted operational features.

Elite serves OEMs in regulated and performance-driven sectors. Its customer base spans medical and life science, aerospace, defence, energy, telecommunications, industrial, off-highway vehicles, space, and Internet of Things applications. The firm highlights JOSCAR registration for defence supply-chain access and ISO 27001 certification for data security.

The company states its purpose as improving the lives it touches and the world it lives in. It emphasizes a dedicated NPI process, world-class manufacturing standards, full sourcing capability, and global logistics expertise as differentiators built over more than 35 years of experience.
